name: imperial_script
description: Imperial Script is a formal script font with clean connections and an elegant look. The thin connectors combined with the heavier shade strokes makes Imperial perfect for invitations, formal events and seasonal settings. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/imperial-script .
